method: New intros and endings with re-used original Rubicon roll sounds

06-d20-shuffled-sets.mp3.title: D20 · Shuffled Sets
coda_text: No. The die has twenty faces. The extra number was not in the record yesterday.
06-d20-shuffled-sets.mp3.spoken_intro_text: No one here agrees upon the first rule of the game. They are quite certain of the last. I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast. Twenty faces, eighteen shuffled sets. Each set contains every number once. Seek to the next complete result.
06-d20-shuffled-sets.mp3.standard_intro: I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast.

07-d20-giant-shuffle.mp3.title: D20 · One Giant Shuffle
coda_text: That is not the order in which I left them.
07-d20-giant-shuffle.mp3.spoken_intro_text: I have been asked whether chance can lie. I have never discovered that it speaks. I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast. Twenty faces, eighteen copies of each, shuffled together as one great set. Seek to the next complete result.
07-d20-giant-shuffle.mp3.standard_intro: I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast.

08-d20-pair-balanced.mp3.title: D20 · Every Possible Pair
coda_text: Every possible pair has now met.
One has asked not to be introduced again.
08-d20-pair-balanced.mp3.spoken_intro_text: In our oldest register, there is a place left for a name that has not yet been given. Beneath it is a number. I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast. Twenty faces. Every possible consecutive pair appears once in the complete circle. Seek to the next complete result.
08-d20-pair-balanced.mp3.standard_intro: I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast.

09-2d6-balanced.mp3.title: 2D6 · Thirty-Six Possibilities
coda_text: The first die has gone missing.
The second insists that there was never another.
09-2d6-balanced.mp3.spoken_intro_text: Our abbot keeps the keys, and I keep the tally. It is not certain which of us has the heavier duty. I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast. Two six-sided dice. All thirty-six possible pairs appear in each shuffle. Hear both dice and their sum.
09-2d6-balanced.mp3.standard_intro: I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast.

10-d100-balanced.mp3.title: D100 · Three Complete Shuffles
coda_text: I have numbered the doors from one to a hundred.
The exit, naturally, has no number.
10-d100-balanced.mp3.spoken_intro_text: There is a road through the wood which appears upon no map. Nevertheless, the milestones are carefully numbered. I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast. One hundred faces, shuffled in three complete sets. Every number appears three times. Seek to the next complete result.
10-d100-balanced.mp3.standard_intro: I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast.

11-d4-balanced.mp3.title: D4 · Four Paths
coda_text: There were four ways from the crossing.
11-d4-balanced.mp3.spoken_intro_text: At the blackthorn, the road divides. Both ways are marked as the shorter. I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast. Four faces, ninety shuffled sets. Take the next complete number.
11-d4-balanced.mp3.standard_intro: I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast.

12-d8-balanced.mp3.title: D8 · Eight Paths
coda_text: The bell has rung eight times.
12-d8-balanced.mp3.spoken_intro_text: There are hours appointed for prayer, for labor, and for rest. There is no appointed hour for chance. I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast. Eight faces, forty-five shuffled sets. Take the next complete number.
12-d8-balanced.mp3.standard_intro: I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast.

13-d12-balanced.mp3.title: D12 · Twelve Paths
coda_text: I believe that was the last.
I had been told there would be one more.
13-d12-balanced.mp3.spoken_intro_text: In the oldest days, men cast lots to discover what they could not otherwise know. Some of their questions were better left unanswered. I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast. Twelve faces, thirty shuffled sets. Take the next complete number.
13-d12-balanced.mp3.standard_intro: I am Brother Rubicon. The die's cast.
